programme.title: Paris When It Sizzles

programme.desc: In this provocatively daring film, an attention-seeking schoolgirl vengefully spreads rumors that her teachers (Audrey Hepburn and Shirley MacLaine) are lesbians.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster stars in the true story of killer Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz, and who educated himself, becoming a world renowned authority on birds. Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas and Karl Malden co-star.

programme.title: Another Time, Another Place
programme.desc: Mark Trevor, a World War II newsman with the British Broadcasting Corporation who's torn between two women. One is Sara Scott, the American reporter working in England. The two embark on a romance – but it's an affair destined for tragedy.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay, 13 HOURS is the gripping true story of six elite ex-military operators assigned to protect the CIA who fought back against overwhelming odds when terrorists attacked a U.S. diplomatic compound on September 11, 2012.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: The Messengers (2007)
programme.desc: An ominous darkness invades a seemingly serene sunflower farm in North Dakota, and the Solomon family is torn apart by suspicion, mayhem and murder.

programme.title: Drop Zone
programme.desc: Wesley Snipes free-falls into the daredevil world of sky-diving to track down a cadre of techno terrorists in Drop Zone, a chute-to-thrill adventure co-starring Gary Busey, Yancy Butler, Michael Jeter and more.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Lady Snowblood
programme.desc: A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Upon arriving in Hong Kong, an American woman is beaten up and mugged by thugs. She's taken in by a martial arts master who trains her for a formidable fight competition known as the Kumite.

programme.title: Gladiator Underground
programme.desc: Two brothers compete in the world’s deadliest underground fighting tournament where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Autumn In New York
programme.desc: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: Two strangers meet and fall in love during the weekend that they are planning their respective weddings.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: When the Clark Family moves from Chicago to Cradle Bay, Steve is cautioned by Gavin Strick about the separating factions at the local high school, where the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic perfect students, rule.

programme.title: Coherence
programme.desc: In this mind-bending sci-fi thriller, 8 friends at a dinner party start experiencing strange and mysterious events on the night a comet is passing close to Earth. Soon it becomes clear that nothing and no one are what they appear.

programme.title: Eddie and the Cruisers
programme.desc: A reporter begins tracking down rumors of an unreleased album by a rock band whose charismatic leader disappeared after an accident and was presumed dead years before.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Two young aspiring outlaws (Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane) manage to join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang, led by the aging Bill Doolin (Burt Lancaster). The gang’s heyday may be far behind them, but there’s still plenty of adventure left!

programme.title: Out of Liberty
programme.desc: n the winter of 1839, a jailer in Liberty, Missouri, has to watch over the most dangerous men in the state while they await trial. He faces two dangers: the one that comes from the prisoners and the one that lurks behind the walls of the prison.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Vampire's Kiss
programme.desc: Teetering on the edge of sanity, volatile literary agent Peter Loew (Nicolas Cage) tries to find purpose in his life through a cutthroat work ethic and a hedonistic nightlife.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Sean Penn's breakthrough dramatic performance.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons' family reunion goes awry when their home comes under siege by a mask-wearing team of crossbow-bearing assailants.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: A woman who is the last to leave her office on Christmas Eve must rely on her wits to survive when she is trapped in a parking garage with a deranged security guard.

programme.title: Girl on the Third Floor
programme.desc: Don Koch (Phil "CM Punk" Brooks) tries to renovate a rundown house with a sordid history for his growing family, only to learn that the house has other plans.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a veteran cop and his new partner are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the barrios and slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: A psycho-killer stalks two New York City women--one a frustrated housewife, the other a street-smart hooker who teams up with the first woman's son to trap the murderer. The film reaches a shocking climax when the slayer's real identity is revealed.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: The film probes the psyche of the young soldiers who fought in Vietnam. Their camaraderie, their struggle for survival amid terrifying violence and madness of combat.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: When a couple of young astronomers discover an enormous comet on course to collide with Earth, the countdown to doomsday begins, and the human race embarks on the fight for survival.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: When an expedition to the African Congo ends in disaster, a new team is assembled to find out what went wrong.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: A fast-paced Action-Thriller about adults living in a crime-ridden area. The are tired of being bullied, and take matters into their own hands to rid the town of the criminals.

programme.title: Get Shorty
programme.desc: Golden Globe® winner John Travolta stars with Gene Hackman, Danny DeVito and Rene Russo in this wildly popular comedy of a gangster who turns into a big-time producer after he travels to Hollywood to collect a debt from a down-and-out filmmaker.

programme.title: 8 Heads in a Duffel Bag
programme.desc: All gangster Tommy Spinelli wants to do is deliver his carry-on duffel bag to his boss. Unfortunately, the bag is switched with a Mexican-bound medical student...who has no idea that the bag contains the severed heads of eight Los Angeles gangsters!

programme.title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead
programme.desc: The filmization of Tom Stoppard's immensely witty Shakespearean spin-off, which changes the tone of Hamlet from a tragedy to a Comedy.

programme.title: Vincent & Theo
programme.desc: An emotionally powerful look at the symbiotic relationship between Vincent Van Gogh and his brother Theo.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: First Knight
programme.desc: Together, Sean Connery, Richard Gere, Julia Ormond (Legends of the Fall, Sabrina) and Jerry Zucker, the director of Ghost, bring you a new vision of King Arthur's Camelot.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Man Of Tai Chi
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves makes his directorial debut in this explosive martial arts drama that reunites him with legendary Matrix Trilogy fight choreographer Yuen Wo Ping and stuntman Tiger Chen.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: A playboy tries to win over the girl of his dreams when he discovers she has no short-term memory.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: The Jennings fight for their daughter's life after she is kidnapped by an experienced gang of thieves.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: Based on a true story, two brothers, against all the odds, come together to train for a historic title bout that has the power to reunite their fractured family and give their hard-luck town what it's been waiting for: pride.

programme.title: Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: The summer of 1964... Two FBI agents--one a tight-jawed, by-the-book type, the other an experienced Southern lawman who knows how to handle people--head the government's investigation into the disappearance of three civil rights activists in Mississippi.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: End of the Rope
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Sheriff Jacobson and Attorney Taylor investigate the disappearance of the Haven Family while facing a town bent on vengeance against suspect Charles Bannon.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: The story of Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez), a single mother born in the boroughs of New York City, who works as a maid in a first-class Manhattan hotel. By a twist of fate and mistaken identity, Marisa meets Christopher Marshall (Ralph Fiennes)

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Hellraiser
programme.desc: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

programme.title: Hellraiser II: Hellbound
programme.desc: Kirsty is brought to an institution after the horrible events of Hellraiser (1987), where the occult-obsessive head doctor resurrects Julia and unleashes the Cenobites and their demonic underworld.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Prey (2007)
programme.desc: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann directs this stylishly photographed action-packed drama that stars James Caan as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman (Tuesday Weld).

programme.title: River's Edge
programme.desc: The lives of a group of teenagers are thrown into a moral spin when one murders his girlfriend. Faced with the brutal reality of death, each must decide whether to turn their friend in to the police.

programme.title: The Time Machine
programme.desc: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Beowulf
programme.desc: After Beowulf, the mightiest warrior of all, destroyes the overpowering demon Grendel, he incurs wrath of the beast's mother to seek out revenge.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Director James Mangold (FORD vs FERRARI) extends his crime thriller classic that brings together a powerhouse cast, including Robert De Niro, Sylvester Stallone, Ray Liotta, and Harvey Keitel.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, Geena Davis and Susan Sarandon ride to everlasting fame as two women who embark on a crime spree across the American southwest.

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: First Knight
programme.desc: Together, Sean Connery, Richard Gere, Julia Ormond (Legends of the Fall, Sabrina) and Jerry Zucker, the director of Ghost, bring you a new vision of King Arthur's Camelot.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This dazzling remake of the 1956 spine-tingler stars Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Jeff Goldblum, Leonard Nimoy and Veronica Cartwright in an eerie tale of possession by "alien pods."

programme.title: King Kong (1976)
programme.desc: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: Ex Machina
programme.desc: A young programmer (Domhnall Gleeson) at an internet company is chosen by a reclusive CEO (Oscar Isaac) to evaluate the capabilities and consciousness of a beautiful and sophisticated robot (Alicia Vikander).

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Max and the gang's worlds converge when the gang wants Max as badly as he wants them, especially after they target him for the death of their former leader.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: Cold Mountain
programme.desc: A dramatic tale of love and survival set at the dawn of the Civil War. Nicole Kidman, Jude Law and Renée Zellweger star in Academy Award winning director Anthony Minghella's (THE ENGLISH PATIENT) captivating and poignant film.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Winner of 6 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, and based on the hit Broadway musical, Chicago is a dazzling spectacle cheered by audiences and critics alike, where crimes of passion make way for legends to those seeking the spotlight.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: Recruited by Matt Graver, FBI agent Kate Macer joins a task force for the escalating war against drugs. Led by the intense Alejandro, the team travels back-and-forth across the U.S.-Mexican border, using one cartel boss to flush out a bigger one.

programme.title: Mud
programme.desc: On a Mississippi River island, two young friends (Tye Sheridan, Jacob Lofland) encounter a fugitive (Matthew McConaughey) whose wild tales about a beautiful woman and a line of bounty hunters come true.

programme.title: Secret in Their Eyes
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Chiwetel Ejiofor) spends 13 years investigating the brutal murder of a colleague's (Julia Roberts) daughter, then uncovers a new clue that leads to a dark and shocking secret.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D. and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earths closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

programme.title: Selma

programme.title: Out Of Sync
programme.desc: After he is released from prison, a former DJ tries to go straight and put his various vices behind him.

programme.title: On the Come Up
programme.desc: The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

programme.title: Gladiator

programme.title: Shooter

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: A businessman gets caught up in a criminal conspiracy during his daily commute home and works against the clock to stop a deadly attack to save the lives of his fellow passengers.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Drumline
programme.desc: A drummer helps his Atlanta College marching band defeat a rival in a Southern battle-of-the-bands.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme is Lyon Gaultier, a deserter in the French Foreign Legion who travels to the USA and enters the gory world of bare-knuckled street fighting in order to make money to save his brother's life and family.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Real Genius
programme.desc: When a group of crazy college geniuses puts their heads together, almost anything can happen. Hold on for a freewheeling, uproarious look at just how much mischief a bunch of high-IQers can concoct. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: A playboy tries to win over the girl of his dreams when he discovers she has no short-term memory.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: The story of Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez), a single mother born in the boroughs of New York City, who works as a maid in a first-class Manhattan hotel. By a twist of fate and mistaken identity, Marisa meets Christopher Marshall (Ralph Fiennes)

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: The Jennings fight for their daughter's life after she is kidnapped by an experienced gang of thieves.

programme.title: The Net
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Dennis Miller and Jeremy Northam star in this hit thriller about a computer expert whose life is "erased" by a computer conspiracy. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: The summer of 1964... Two FBI agents--one a tight-jawed, by-the-book type, the other an experienced Southern lawman who knows how to handle people--head the government's investigation into the disappearance of three civil rights activists in Mississippi.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: American Outlaws
programme.desc: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with the powerful Transformers faction, the Maximals, to save Earth.

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: The story of Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez), a single mother born in the boroughs of New York City, who works as a maid in a first-class Manhattan hotel. By a twist of fate and mistaken identity, Marisa meets Christopher Marshall (Ralph Fiennes)

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Kicking & Screaming (2005)
programme.desc: Will Ferrell plays a suburban dad who turns into a maniac when he takes on the role of coach for his son's unruly soccer team. He faces off against his own domineering father, portrayed by Robert Duvall.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: In 2047, a team of astronauts embarks on a mission to retrieve a missing spaceship. However, their simple retrieval job leads to something far more terrifying than any of them would suspect.

programme.title: Prey (2007)
programme.desc: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: A woman who is the last to leave her office on Christmas Eve must rely on her wits to survive when she is trapped in a parking garage with a deranged security guard.

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons' family reunion goes awry when their home comes under siege by a mask-wearing team of crossbow-bearing assailants.

programme.title: River's Edge
programme.desc: The lives of a group of teenagers are thrown into a moral spin when one murders his girlfriend. Faced with the brutal reality of death, each must decide whether to turn their friend in to the police.

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Susan
programme.desc: A bored New Jersey suburban housewife's fascination with a kooky character she's read about in the personal columns leads to her being mistaken for the woman herself.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Beowulf
programme.desc: After Beowulf, the mightiest warrior of all, destroyes the overpowering demon Grendel, he incurs wrath of the beast's mother to seek out revenge.

programme.title: The Time Machine
programme.desc: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: The true story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of the nation as well.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: Seven Samurai
programme.desc: Farmers from a village exploited by bandits hire a veteran samurai for protection, and he gathers six other samurai to join him.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: King Kong (1976)
programme.desc: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Winner of 6 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, and based on the hit Broadway musical, Chicago is a dazzling spectacle cheered by audiences and critics alike, where crimes of passion make way for legends to those seeking the spotlight.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

programme.title: Shooter

programme.title: Parker

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility.

programme.title: Overlord

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic that has spread around the world.

programme.title: Drumline
programme.desc: A drummer helps his Atlanta College marching band defeat a rival in a Southern battle-of-the-bands.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

programme.title: Timecop
programme.desc: Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: A playboy tries to win over the girl of his dreams when he discovers she has no short-term memory.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Superstars Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman and Julia Roberts star in award-winning director Steve Spielberg's updating of PETER PAN.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with the powerful Transformers faction, the Maximals, to save Earth.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Kicking & Screaming (2005)
programme.desc: Will Ferrell plays a suburban dad who turns into a maniac when he takes on the role of coach for his son's unruly soccer team. He faces off against his own domineering father, portrayed by Robert Duvall.

programme.title: Do the Right Thing
programme.desc: Spike Lee wrote, produced, directed, and starred in this critically acclaimed comedy-drama, featuring Danny Aiello, chronicling the hottest day of the year in a diverse Brooklyn neighborhood.

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: In 2047, a team of astronauts embarks on a mission to retrieve a missing spaceship. However, their simple retrieval job leads to something far more terrifying than any of them would suspect.

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: When an ancient Egyptian artifact is discovered, two men unlock its secret power as a portal through time and space.

programme.title: You're Next
programme.desc: The Davisons' family reunion goes awry when their home comes under siege by a mask-wearing team of crossbow-bearing assailants.

programme.title: Hell House LLC.
programme.desc: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: The true story of the undersized Depression-era racehorse whose victories lifted not only the spirits of the team behind it but also those of the nation as well.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Seven Samurai
programme.desc: Farmers from a village exploited by bandits hire a veteran samurai for protection, and he gathers six other samurai to join him.

programme.title: High And Low
programme.desc: An executive of a Yokohama shoe company becomes a victim of extortion when his chauffeur's son is kidnapped by mistake and held for ransom.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Hair
programme.desc: A country boy and Vietnam draftee embark on an adventure of a lifetime when he meets a group of counterculture hippies and his eyes are opened to the darker side of class, race, and big city life in this adaptation of the Broadway sensation.

programme.title: Grease

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege to the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In the future, mankind has outlawed the things that trigger emotion-literature, music, and art. To uphold the law, a special breed of police is assigned to eliminate all transgressors. Christian Bale stars in this awesome high-tech action thriller.

programme.title: The Marsh King's Daughter
programme.desc: A young mother must confront her long-buried past as the child of a kidnapper and the girl he held captive when her father breaks out of prison. Convinced he intends to take her daughters, she sets out to find and kill him herself.

programme.title: The Shadow of Violence
programme.desc: A former boxer cares for his autistic son while working as an enforcer for a family of drug dealers in rural Ireland.

programme.title: Sicario

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

programme.title: Cupido navideño

programme.title: Amor a Segunda Vista

programme.title: Venganza Brutal: Hombre Sin Ley

programme.title: Kermesse

programme.title: La duquesa Tepetate

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Fallaste! La Decisión Final De Kakashi
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura hacen todo lo posible para aprobar el examen de supervivencia. ¡Pero serán necesarios los sabios consejos de Kakashi para enseñarles a estos ninjas egoístas lo que significa trabajar en equipo!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Una Misión Peligrosa! Un Viaje A La Tierra De Las Olas
programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros comienzan sus primeras misiones ninja. Son tareas aburridas, enojadas y frustradas, y Naruto se alivia diciéndole todo al Hokage. Entretenido por el entusiasmo de Naruto, les asigna una nueva misión: proteger al viejo Tazuna.

programme.title: Naruto: El Asesino De La Neblina
programme.desc: Naruto y su grupo llegan a Tierra de las Olas,donde un malvado hombre llamado Gato se apodero del lugar. Allí aparece Zabuza, contratado por Gato para matar a Tazuna. Naruto está deseando enfrentarse a este asesino ninja. ¿Estará listo para este desafío?

programme.title: Naruto: El Juramento Del Dolor
programme.desc: Kakashi se pone delante durante la batalla contra Zabuza. Pero ¡todo cambia cuando Kakashi es atrapado en la Prisión de Agua de Zabuza! Kakashi pide que huyan, pero Naruto recuerda la promesa que hizo -no volver a huir nunca más- y se mantiene firme!

programme.title: Naruto: Kakashi: Guerrero Sharingan
programme.desc: Gracias al plan de Naruto, Kakashi se libera de la Prisión de Agua y derrota a Zabuza. Un misterioso ninja aparece de repente y acaba con Zabuza antes de que Kakashi lo haga. Naruto se sorprende al ver que un muchacho ha podido derrotar a Zabuza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Bosque Del Chakra
programme.desc: Kakashi no está satisfecho con el resultado de la batalla, cree que Zabuza no ha muerto. Kakashi decide poner en marcha un interesante entrenamiento que permitirá a Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura controlar mejor su chakra.

programme.title: Naruto: El País Donde Existió un Héroe
programme.desc: Sakura y Tazuna van a la aldea, y ven sufrimiento de habitantes de la Tierras a causa de Gato, por eso Tazuna arriesga su vida. Con un puente, los habitantes no dependerían de Gato, quien controla todos los negocios. Naruto y Sasuke continúan entrenando.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Batalla En El Puente! ¡Zabuza Regresa!
programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Naruto: El Jutsu Secreto De Haku, Los Espejos Cristal De Hielo
programme.desc: Llega el momento de enfrentarse a Zabuza pero en esta ocasión tiene compañía: el ninja rastreador. Él y su compañero se fijan en las habilidades de Sasuke, y los dos se da cuenta del poder que oculta el ninja enmascarado. La batalla comienza.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan ha ahorrado suficiente dinero para comprar una nueva bicicleta justo a tiempo para Navidad, pero ¿gastará ese dinero solo para él? ¿O habrá un espacio en su corazón para el espíritu navideño?

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan entra en pánico cuando la directora de la escuela pide una reunión con él y sus padres. Pensando que hizo algo malo, decide contratar a dos actores para que hagan de sus padres durante la cita.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es el Día de Acción de Gracias y el padre de Kenan ha preparado un pavo. Pero cuando nadie está en la cocina, Kel no puede resistir la tentación y se devora el pavo en cuestión de minutos. Ahora Kenan y Kel están en grandes problemas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una maestra sustituta en la clase y Kel está seguro de que ella está enamorada de Kenan. Kenan no le cree al principio, pero Kel es persistente y persuasivo. Comienza a convencer a Kenan de que puede tener razón.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel deciden saltarse un día de escuela y trabajo. Se hacen pasar por enfermos, pero pronto se encuentran en grandes problemas, cuando son atrapados en un robo de banco y terminan apareciendo en las noticias.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel están en el trabajo cuando un payaso de circo entra en Rigby’s y roba la tienda. Las cosas empeoran cuando el mismo payaso aparece más tarde en la fiesta de cumpleaños de Kyra, y los muchachos deciden entrar en acción.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel gana 64 millones de dólares en la lotería y quiere dividir el premio con su mejor amigo, Kenan. Parece que las cosas están saliendo bastante bien para ambos, hasta que Kel pierde el billete ganador.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Repasamos la historia del RPG de accion por excelencia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hoy hablaremos del juego de plataformas 2D por excelencia y su impresionante salto entre los 8 y 16 bits. Esta es la historia detras de Super Mario World

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos sobre la arriesgada apuesta de Gearbox Software que dio origen al genero Loot Shooter como lo conocemos. Esta es la historia de Borderlands.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la histroia de Super Metroid, un titulo de calibre legendario que estuvo 3 veces en el borde de la cancelacion.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la historia detras de Final Fantasy VII, el juego de Square que popularizo los RPG en todo el mundo. Final Fantasy VII llevo al genero y a los videojuegos mas alla de sus limites.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: En los 90, nadie hubiera imaginado que Nintendo estuviera al frente del genero de peleas con el titulo con mayor presencia y mejores ventas en la industria de los videojuegos

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la historia del videojuego que puso a Polonia en el ojo de la industria, y cuyo climax, nos entrego uno de los titulos RPG mas celebrados y condecorados de la octava generacion de consolas

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Monster Hunter se convirtió en una de las franquicias más reconocidas de Capcom a lo largo de su historia. Desde su debut en 2004, se ha colado a las listas de lo más vendido de la compañía japonesa

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Bully, desarrollado por Rockstar Vancouver (antes Barking Dog Studios), es una de las entregas más peculiares de Rockstar Games por alejarse de los hampones y la vida del crímen.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hace muchos anos las mascotas de videojuegos que dominaban el mercado eran 2: Mario de Nintendo y Sonic de SEGA. Esto cambio con Crash Bandicoot en PlayStation. En seguida, te contamos su historia.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de revisar el clasico hit de 2005 desarrollado por SCE Santa Monica Studio para PlayStation 2: God of War.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de contarte sobre la creacion del grupo de asesinos que juraron proteger al mundo de La Orden de los Templarios. Nada es verdad, todo esta permitido. Esta es la historia detras de: Assassin's Creed.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de revisar la historia de desarrollo de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Rare; unico, singular. Extraordinario. Dice la leyenda que su nivel era tan alto, que llego a poner celoso a mas de uno, incluso al mismisimo Shigueru Miyamoto. Por esto, es momento de ver la historia detras de Banjo Kazooie.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Bienvenidos al especial de The Legend of Zelda de Cybernet. Haremos un recuento por la evolución de una de las series más famosas de la historia y en nuestro Top 10 recordaremos a los mejores jefes de la franquicia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: El erizo azul más famoso de los videojuegos llega a Cybernet con una retrospectiva donde recordaremos sus mejores juegos, y alguno que otro resbalón que ha tenido en su carrera.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: A todos nos gustan las consolas portátiles, pero ¿saben cómo surgieron? En el episodio de hoy de Cybernet les contaremos cómo fue que surgió esta rama de la industria. También celebraremos a la heroína más grande de Nintendo con un especial de Metroid.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¡El fútbol llegó a Cybernet! En el episodio de hoy conoceremos cómo fueron evolucionando los videojuegos de fútbol y cuáles han sido sus mejores series. ¿Cuál es su juego de fútbol favorito?

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Zoro aterriza en una isla donde tiene un desagradable con Perona, una vieja conocida de Thriller Bark. Por otra parte, Brook ha llegado a un lugar donde parece que unos invocadores lo confunden con Satán, el rey de los demonios.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Finalmente, y gracias a la inestimable ayuda de Hancock, Luffy consigue llegar a Impel Down, la prisión donde tienen encerrado a su hermano.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Una vez dentro de Impel Down, Luffy y Hancock se separan para ir cada uno por su lado. Mientras Luffy va recorriendo la prisión en busca de Ace se encuentra con un prisionero que está intentando fugarse y a quien conoce bastante bien: Buggy el Payaso.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: A pesar de la reticencia de Buggy, al final este accede a ayudar a Luffy para encontrar a su hermano Ace en Impel Down. Gracias a su ayuda podrán ir avanzando poco a poco en los diferentes pisos de la prisión.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Luffy y Buggy consiguen llegar al segundo piso de Impel Down y empezarán a enfrentarse a las bestias salvajes del Infierno. Por otro lado, Boa conoce al alcaide de la prisión, Magellan, quien cae rendido ante la belleza de la Emperatriz Pirata.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: La historia hace un pequeño alto en el camino y nos narra una aventura previa que tuvieron los Sombrero de Paja.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Algunos de los Sombrero de Paja llegan a Kansorn, también conocida como la Little East Blue, que está llena de sitios emblemáticos del lugar de origen de los protagonistas.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Los Piratas Amigo están causando muchos problemas en Little East Blue porque quieren llevarse al escarabajo gigante. Aunque Luffy y compañía intentan evitarlo, el molesto poder de Largo los deja fuera de combate y todo parece perdido.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Gracias a la ayuda de los aldeanos de Little East Blue, Luffy consigue separar a Largo de su grupo y comienza un duelo uno contra uno para poner punto y final a esta situación.

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: La verdadera identidad del Rey de los Orphenocs se revela, dejando a Takumi en plena agonía...

programme.title: Kamen Rider 555 - Faiz
programme.desc: Takumi desaparece, preocupando a Mari y a los demás, quienes se preguntan por qué atacó a Teruo.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Makoto Hikawa investiga asesinatos inexplicables que no parecen haber sido cometidos por personas comunes. En medio de esto, los cuerpos de dos jóvenes parecen sufrir una especie de anomalía cada vez que ocurren tales asesinatos.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Una foto se convierte en la pista de un caso en el que el hijo y sus padres mueren de una manera muy extraña. Makoto y sus colegas policías notan un detalle curioso contenido en tal foto.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Se encontró un cadáver en un suelo del Período Joumon. No había signos de que hubiera sido excavado y enterrado allí, y la policía sospecha que fue obra de un Desconocido.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Los problemas físicos de Ryou cada vez son peores, ya que es uno de los afectados por los Desconocidos cuando inician sus ataques.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: La primera víctima de The Unknown es el padre de Mayumi. Para protegerse del ataque de un Desconocido, Ryou se transforma frente a Mayumi y ella huye asustada.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Un niño misterioso aparece ante Ryou, que sufre los efectos de su metamorfosis. Mientras tanto, Shouichi encuentra un artículo de periódico que hablaba sobre la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Agito
programme.desc: Una mujer parece conocer el pasado de Shouichi, su nombre es Tomoko Miura. Pasa el tiempo y Tomoko es encontrada muerta en un parque, envuelta en cables.

programme.title: Jugando al Escondite con la Familia Tiburón - Season 1 LATAM
programme.desc: ¿Eh? ¿Dónde se escondió la Familia Tiburón? ¡Encontremos juntos a la Familia Tiburón con Pinkfong!

programme.title: Juguete & Canción

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En la víspera del eclipse, la ansiedad de Aang saca lo peor de él. Sus sueños se convierten en pesadillas y pronto ya no puede distinguir el sueño de la realidad.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Depeche Mode Touring the Angel: Live in Milan

programme.title: Expreso de muerte

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Un robo a un banco entrelaza las vidas del director de la sucursal, un restaurador, una joven policía embarazada, un policía veterano, y una docena de personas. Vivirán varias horas en compañía de cuatro ladrones con perfiles muy diferentes.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Una joven policía, da suministros a los rehenes, uno de los cuatro ladrones está enfermo y necesita insulina. El Comisionado acepta darle una dosis a cambio de un rehén. En el sótano, dos cómplices perforan una pared que da acceso a la bóveda.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Alex accede a la bóveda, y a un botín de ocho millones de euros. Los rehenes siguen atados con sus ojos vendados. Los ladrones se preparan para evacuar el banco a través de los sótanos.

programme.title: Una chica en apuros
programme.desc: Surgen complicaciones románticas cuando una estudiante se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo y lo sustituye en su internado.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: Un agente de viajes endeudado (Robin Williams) intenta conseguir un millón de dólares afirmando que un cadáver es su hermano desaparecido.

programme.title: Perdido en la fama
programme.desc: La esposa de una estrella de rock ya entrada en años es secuestrada mientras está de vacaciones en Chile.

programme.title: Fool Proof
programme.desc: Un ingenioso trío de ladrones disfrazados debe luchar por sus vidas y el botín cuando un verdadero criminal maestro los chantajea para que planifiquen y ejecuten un atraco de $20 millones. Protagonizada por Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: La Venganza de Jack
programme.desc: Un periodista investiga asesinatos en Londres y recibe cartas del Destripador, lo que pone en peligro su vida y la de otros.

programme.title: Burga
programme.desc: Tras despertar en un hospital psiquiátrico sin recordar cómo llegó allí, una mujer experimenta visiones aterradoras mientras intenta escapar desesperadamente.

programme.title: A Cure for Wellness
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo debe salvar a su jefe de un "centro de bienestar" que mantiene adictos a sus pacientes.

programme.title: Charlatán
programme.desc: Esta es la sorprendente historia de un hombre que tiene una habilidad inusual, pero que se encuentra en el escenario totalitario y opresivo de la década de 1950 y sufre las consecuencias de esto.

programme.desc: Una joven de procedencia humilde se casa con un doctor de una pequeña ciudad. Atrapada en un matrimonio que no la satisface, busca consuelo teniendo relaciones extra conyugales que, además, la ayudan a medrar socialmente.

programme.title: La Estafa

programme.title: En busca de venganza

programme.title: Armados y peligrosos
programme.desc: Dos criminales se meten en problemas con la patrulla fronteriza de los Estados Unidos, después de reunirse con un narcotraficante mexicano.

programme.title: La gran explosión
programme.desc: Una noche, en Los Ángeles, el investigador privado Ned Cruz (Antonio Banderas) recibe la visita de un boxeador ruso, recientemente puesto en libertad condicional, que le propone un misterioso trabajo: encontrar a Lexie, su novia desaparecida, y diamantes.

programme.title: El chico hormiga 3
programme.desc: La Pulga, el archienemigo de Antboy, consigue su libertad. Nada más salir del centro psiquiátrico, Alicia Dufort, la presidenta de Exofarm, lo recluta para recrear de nuevo el suero Hércules.

programme.title: Dos chicos en fuga
programme.desc: Dos niños de un pequeño pueblo prueban su coraje cuando accidentalmente se escapan a bordo de un avión propiedad de la mafia.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: Una nave espacial con forma humana tiene 48 horas para recuperar el orbe y arrojarlo al océano.

programme.title: Cupido navideño
programme.desc: Dos asistentes ejecutivos muy trabajadores, hacen arreglos para que sus jefes se enamoren durante las vacaciones.

programme.title: Intercambio navideño
programme.desc: Las gemelas Maya y Ana, separadas al nacer y con vidas totalmente distintas, se descubren e intercambian vidas por una noche, alterando sus destinos para siempre.

programme.title: Family for the Holidays, A
programme.desc: La Navidad pasada, Miranda se enamoró de Ian mientras buscaba a su padre perdido hace mucho tiempo. Miranda accedió a mantener su identidad en secreto para evitar un escándalo, pero un texto anónimo amenaza con exponerla. ¿Podrá Miranda salvar la Navidad?

programme.title: Christmas Chalet, The
programme.desc: Una amante de la Navidad y divorciada reserva un viaje a un chalet con su madre y su hija. Sin embargo, el mismo chalet está reservado para un único escritor que odia la Navidad. Juntos aprenden la magia de la Navidad y la familia.

programme.title: Corazón de un corredor
programme.desc: Después de la trágica muerte de su novia en un accidente, Kevin descubre que correr es una forma de lidiar con su sufrimiento. Gracias a su entrenador, aprende a superar sus desafíos internos y, paso a paso, a recobrar las ganas de vivir de nuevo.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: Vida y hechos de Mary Wollstonecraft Godwin, quien a los 16 años conoció al poeta Percy Shelley, de 21 años, lo que resultó en la escritura de Frankenstein.

programme.title: Un pedacito de cielo
programme.desc: Marley (Kate Hudson) es una mujer joven que descubre que se está muriendo de cáncer, pero cuando de forma inesperada se enamora de su médico (Gael García Bernal), la amenaza de caer en el amor es más aterradora que la muerte.

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: Una pareja descubre una inquietante presencia en fotografías de un supuesto accidente.

programme.title: El Hechicero del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cocinero clarividente se une a su novia y al sheriff de la ciudad para prevenir una catástrofe desconocida que puede estar vinculado a un extraño con un comportamiento sospechoso.

programme.title: Caída Libre

programme.title: Venganza Brutal: Hombre Sin Ley
programme.desc: Lulu la hija de Celso y Evelia tiene un novio que anda en malos pasos involucrado en matanzas, asaltos y otros crímenes, Lulu no tiene ni la menor idea de la vida oculta de su novio pero el destino la pondrá frente a frente con la realidad.

programme.title: Vidas Violentas
programme.desc: Integrada por seis cortometrajes escritos y dirigidos por seis de los más connotados directores mexicanos, la película fue realizada y dirigida para concientizar y reducir la violencia de género, el acoso escolar en las escuelas y la violencia doméstica

programme.title: Welcome to Tijuana

programme.title: La Casa Colorada

programme.title: La Casa Que Arde De Noche

programme.title: La Feria De La Canción Aka Su Primer Amor
programme.desc: Un joven periodista organiza un concurso de canciones, la idea resulta un éxito y el ganador termina siendo una sorpresa, al tiempo que este profesional de la comunicación disfruta de las bondades del primer amor.

programme.title: El Matador

programme.title: Institnto predador
programme.desc: Frank captura animales salvajes en la jungla brasileña, incluido un jaguar blanco de 180 kilos. Los embarca en el mismo barco que un asesino arrestado. El asesino se libera y libera a los animales.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: Inspector Eddie Chan es asignado para proteger Wong YatFei, un Rico hombre de negocios. A pesar de los esfuerzos de Eddia, ha secuestrado a Wong.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Una extraña enfermedad afecta a toda la tripulación y hace que el Enterprise quede a la deriva dirigiéndose directamente a un meteorito.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: La teniente Tasha Yar se verá obligada a luchar por salvar su vida durante la visita a un planeta cuya población vive con costumbres ancestrales.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Deanna Troi va a contraer matrimonio con un joven médico conforme a las costumbres de su planeta. Sin embargo, la llegada a la nave de una raza que está sufriendo una terrible enfermedad cambiará su destino.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: CSI: Miami
